clue.text: Joke about girl being straitlaced

indicators.note: the joke word goes around the girl's name, so about signals one piece wrapping the other

parts.note: a pun is a joke on words
Rita is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone teases a prim young woman with a gag.
explanation.definitionFit: A Puritan is a person of strict, severe morals, so the word describes someone prudish and strict.

clue.text: Fruit with many seeds oddly taken to mean grape

indicators.note: oddly suggests the letters are arranged strangely, in a new order

explanation.surface: A seedy fruit is curiously said to mean grape.
explanation.definitionFit: The pomegranate is a fruit packed with many juicy red seeds.

clue.text: Mysterious quality of classical Italian church

parts.note: a Roman is an inhabitant of ancient Rome
CE is the Church of England abbreviation

explanation.surface: An ancient Italian church has an air of mystery.
explanation.definitionFit: Romance here is the glamour or mysterious excitement attached to something remote.

clue.text: Change trains, missing one and not getting to express?

indicators.note: the word trains is missing a letter, so missing signals a deletion

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
someone mute does not speak

explanation.surface: A commuter changes trains, misses one and fails to reach the express.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing one' removes I from TRAINS to leave TRANS.
explanation.definitionFit: To transmute is to transform something into a different form or substance.

clue.text: Delicious drink, new crate sent round

indicators.note: sent round suggests the letters are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: A fresh crate of a tasty beverage is passed around.
explanation.definitionFit: Nectar was the drink of the gods, so it names any delicious beverage.

clue.text: Chess player losing learner's support

indicators.note: the chess player loses a letter, so losing signals taking that letter away

parts.note: Black is one of the two sides in chess
L is the learner-driver plate abbreviation

explanation.surface: A chess player loses a student's backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To back someone is to support them; as a noun, a back is the supporting part of a chair or body.

clue.text: Snake regularly hiding in baobab

indicators.note: regularly takes letters at an even spacing, here the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: A serpent lurks in a baobab tree.
explanation.walkthrough: A baobab is a large African tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A boa is a large constricting snake of the tropical Americas.

clue.text: Dog is company — right good one

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A pet is good company, quite a decent one.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a short-legged Welsh breed of dog, an example of the class.

clue.text: Snake initially makes a move, biting anything

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letters of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A serpent strikes, biting anything near it.
explanation.definitionFit: The mamba is a fast, venomous African snake, an example of the class.

clue.text: Shame a Christmas stealer is promoting church?

indicators.note: promoting raises a piece to the front, so the church letters move up to the start

parts.note: the Grinch is the Dr Seuss character who stole Christmas

explanation.surface: The Grinch is shamed for pushing religion.
explanation.walkthrough: A + GRINCH gives AGRINCH; 'is promoting church' moves CH up to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Chagrin is distress or embarrassment at being humiliated, close in sense to mortification.

clue.text: Songbird, black, in wind

parts.note: night is black, the absence of light
a gale is a strong wind

explanation.surface: A small bird sings in the dark as the wind blows.
explanation.definitionFit: The nightingale is a small brown bird known for its rich song at night.

clue.text: Spirit's good, burning like a fire

parts.note: a fire that is burning is said to be in

explanation.surface: A drink is praised as warming as a blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: Gin is a distilled alcoholic drink, and spirit is the general term for such liquor.

clue.text: Regularly encountering waves restyled as a fringe

indicators.note: restyling hair arranges it differently, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who meets the sea often gets a new haircut with a fringe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regularly' looks like an alternate-letter signal, but it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A seafaring life is one spent travelling by ship, so it constantly meets the ocean's swell.

clue.text: Big sea bird — there's three fewer than expected on the green

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the large ocean-going bird with a huge wingspan

definitions.text: there's three fewer than expected on the green
definitions.meaning: second meaning: in golf, a hole completed in three strokes under par

explanation.walkthrough: In golf, par is the expected score for a hole; birdie is one under, eagle two under, and the bird name for three under follows the pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the great seabird and the golfing score three strokes below par.

clue.text: Street is a place for activity

parts.note: a venue is where an event or activity takes place

explanation.surface: The road is described as somewhere things happen.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad road in a town, often lined with trees, a kind of road.

clue.text: One playing instrument made from old French wood — tango?

parts.note: bois is French for wood
T is tango in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A musician's instrument is made of French timber, perhaps for dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: The oboe is a woodwind instrument, which makes 'wood' fit the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboist is a musician who plays the oboe, a woodwind instrument.

clue.text: An edit's rewritten as an alternative

indicators.note: rewriting the words puts their letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An editor redrafts a piece to offer another version.
explanation.definitionFit: Instead means in place of something else, used as a substitute.

clue.text: Affectionate proposal

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a formal offer or bid for a contract

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a loving marriage offer; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both gentle and loving, and a formal offer submitted to win a contract.

clue.text: Chaps taking time following a labyrinth in confusion

indicators.note: the men come after the maze, so following places them later
the chaps take on the time letter, which joins at their end

parts.note: a maze is a labyrinth
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Men lost in a labyrinth grow bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: Amazement is a state of great surprise or bewilderment, an overwhelmed wonder.

clue.text: Burial mound yielding up British weapon

indicators.note: the mound gives up a letter, so yielding up signals a removal

parts.note: a barrow is an ancient burial mound

explanation.surface: A burial mound reveals an ancient British weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrow is a missile shot from a bow, a projectile used in combat.

clue.text: Serious error getting second home

parts.note: to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A grave mistake comes with staying at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A sin is a moral wrong or transgression, a grave fault.

clue.text: Annoyed with daughter after Henry's middle age

indicators.note: the daughter comes after the rest, at the end
the middle of a word is all of it except its first and last letters

parts.note: the name Henry, with the possessive linking it to its middle
taken as written

explanation.surface: Henry is cross about his daughter as he reaches middle age.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle' takes all of HENRY except its outer letters, leaving ENR.
explanation.definitionFit: Enraged means made very angry, a stronger form of irritated.

clue.text: What may apply grease and a lot of gooey stuff

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: gunk is sticky, gooey matter

explanation.surface: Something spreads grease and sticky muck.
explanation.walkthrough: A grease gun is a tool for forcing lubricant into machinery.
explanation.definitionFit: A grease gun is a hand tool used to pump lubricant into joints and bearings.

clue.text: What's sung with love for each note

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
per means for each
A is a musical note

explanation.surface: A romantic song has love for every note.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a drama set to music in which the parts are sung.

clue.text: Small pale bird

parts.note: wan means pale

explanation.definitionFit: The swan is a large long-necked water bird, an example of the class.

clue.text: Rest live around university

indicators.note: the word for live goes around the university letter

parts.note: to reside is to live somewhere

explanation.surface: Someone has a break while living near a university.
explanation.definitionFit: A residue is what remains after the main part is gone, the remainder.
